plainTranslation:
This person may awaken in you a larger appetite for life. In their presence, pleasure expands. You may feel drawn to celebrate more, give more, forgive more, and say yes to experiences you would normally hold at a distance. There is a temptation to get carried away by what feels good in the moment. This can be a blessing, because it encourages openness, generosity, and joy. But it can also become a kind of unconsciousness when enjoyment begins to run ahead of awareness.

When this works, they help you soften. They may remind you that joy matters, that generosity matters, that life does not have to be all restraint and responsibility. Their presence can pull you out of scarcity and into a more open relationship with pleasure.

The challenge is excess. Too much spending. Too much saying yes because the moment feels good. Too much relying on good feelings to carry the relationship instead of addressing what needs attention. This is where the connection needs honesty. Pleasure is not the problem. Avoidance is. Generosity is not the problem. Lack of limits is.

Let this person broaden your perspective without losing sight of your priorities. This connection works best when both people appreciate the opportunities in front of them while staying realistic.
